text:
incident-bot: Alert: rollout-monitor detected spike in upstream 5xx rate for rollout 'v2-traffic-split' in us-west-2. Health checks failing on 3/4 canaries. metric: request_5xx_rate = 12.4% (threshold 2%). auto-escalation: paging maya.

maya: on it — grabbing logs and dashboards. did this start right after the split? :thinking_face:

ajay: looks like the traffic split finished ~10m ago. I can see the new replica set had a different liveness probe response time.

maya: can you paste the last 50 lines from the pod logs for service-inference?

ajay: ```
[2026-03-15T18:01:12Z] WARN request handler: downstream timeout
[2026-03-15T18:01:13Z] ERROR serve: failed to allocate KV cache for request
[2026-03-15T18:01:14Z] ERROR http: 502 gateway error - runtime oom?
[2026-03-15T18:01:14Z] WARN healthcheck: probe response 503
[2026-03-15T18:01:15Z] ERROR serve: rate-limit drop
```

leah: seeing elevated p95 latency and a sharp increase in memory pressure on the new variant (quantized runtime). GC cycles spike aligning with 5xx.

maya: ok — quick triage: reduce traffic to new variant to avoid customer impact and buy time. Options: (1) revert traffic split to 0% for v2, (2) flip feature flag for v2 off, (3) scale replica/instance type. Which is fastest?

ajay: fastest is to flip traffic back to baseline: `rbctl rollout traffic set service-inference v2 0%` — I can run that now.

maya: do it. annotate with reason = "healthcheck failures after rollout" and link to this thread.

ajay: running now... `rbctl rollout traffic set service-inference v2 0% --reason "healthcheck-fail"`

incident-bot: Action executed: `rbctl rollout traffic set service-inference v2 0%` by ajay at 2026-03-15T18:03:45Z. New traffic split applied.

kate: any visible customer impact? Product is asking if payments or auths were affected.

leah: from metrics: errors/second rolled back to baseline ~30s after traffic change. There were ~120 failed requests in the window, mostly short-lived. No persistent errors on downstream systems.

maya: good — notify support to surface to any customers who reported errors in the last 15m. Kate, can you ping them?

kate: will do. also opening a quick incident ticket with severity P2 — need root cause analysis and rollback postmortem.

ajay: while we stabilized, I want to capture a memory dump from one of the failing pods to send to runtime team. Command I used: `kubectl exec -n prod svc-inference-v2-abc -- /bin/heap-dump -o /tmp/heap.dump`

maya: perfect. leave the pod pinned and don't delete the replica set. Also collect the probe config: liveness and readiness timeouts on v2 look tighter than v1. Might be the mismatch with runtime GC.

leah: forwarding a snippet from the healthcheck config: `readinessProbe: httpGet: path: /health timeoutSeconds: 1 periodSeconds: 5 failureThreshold: 3` — v2 changed `timeoutSeconds` to 1 for speed, that seems aggressive for the quantized backend.

maya: that matches symptoms. Postmortem hypothesis: probe too strict + memory pressure on quantized path causing transient 5xx. Immediate mitigation = revert traffic (done), short-term fix = increase timeout to 5s for v2, long-term = runtime memory tuning or instance type.

ajay: opening PR to change `timeoutSeconds` back to 5 and add a gradual probe tuning test. PR: https://git.internal/repo/infra/healthchecks/pull/492

incident-bot: The on-call schedule shows next handoff to leah in 20m. maya — do you want to hand off after stabilization?

maya: yes. I'll do the 1-line handoff in 15m after I confirm metrics are steady for 10m.

leah: ack — I'll join postmortem and keep monitoring. If errors resurge, escalate to SRE lead.

kate: support notified (ref INC-4589). Customers with errors: tenant-arkos and tenant-pixel reported transient failures; both have been contacted.

maya: final checklist before handoff: (1) traffic reverted (confirmed), (2) heap dump saved and uploaded to artifacts, (3) PR opened for probe tweak, (4) support notified. Anything else?

ajay: adding monitoring alert to suppress noisy alerts during rollout tests: `alert suppression window 20m for alert_id=rollout-5xx-usw2` — I set it for 30m.

maya: good. leaving note: if we see memory OOMs persist after probe tweak, we'll schedule a capacity bump and rerun canary with smaller traffic slice. Handoff in 15m to @leah.

leah: thanks. I'll take over monitoring and own the follow-ups (heap analysis, PR review).

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4589 (P2) — link: https://inc.internal/incidents/INC-4589. Participants: maya, ajay, leah, kate.

maya: thanks team — closing active paging. posting summary to #incidents and will write the short RCA after heap dump analysis. :white_check_mark:
